newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to fine shoppers who don't get receipts.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to fine shoppers who don't get receipts.

text.p: The Argentine government, seeking to crack down on tax evasion, plans to fine shoppers who do not request a receipt after a purchase, the DGI tax service head Carlos Silvani said Monday.

Fines will be "severe, but not killers", he told the daily La Nacion in an interview. "We don't want to punish consumers too dramatically ... We just want to penalize them, as in traffic violations, so that they change their attitude."
Silvani, who took office earlier this month, said the proposal will be included in a bill it plans to send to Congress soon.
The government is using more efficient tax collection as one of its main tools to increase revenues and close a fiscal gap expected between $5 billion and $6 billion this year.
